% Pattern: env/class. The claimproof environment, which classes such as
% lipics define for the proof of a claim, is a proof even when the paper does
% not declare it. Seen in the gold pilot (set X).
% want claim-1 statement/claim 1
% want claimproof-1 proof - proves=claim-1
\documentclass{article}
\newtheorem{claim}{Claim}
\begin{document}
\begin{claim}
Every finite set is small.
\end{claim}
\begin{claimproof}
A finite set has a largest point.
\end{claimproof}
\end{document}
